integrity: The theorem is supported by a self-contained classification proof and two independent complete finite verifiers included as standalone artifacts. Code verifies the finite instance; it does not establish novelty.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the fourteen-vertex Heawood graph; the exact count distinguishes all named-vertex permutations. A globally exhaustive historical priority claim and an independent scholarly audit are not made.
title: All optimal linear arrangements of the Heawood graph
